audience: Shopify merchants who run a loyalty program with Rivo

useCases.title: Find top loyalty members and their VIP tier
useCases.text: List the customers filtered by points range, then open one to read its points balance and VIP tier. List the VIP tiers to see their thresholds and perks.

useCases.title: Review points activity and redemptions
useCases.text: List the points events, such as earnings, spending and adjustments. Open a redemption to read the reward and its discount code.

useCases.title: Check reward use and pending referrals
useCases.text: List the rewards with their points cost and redemption count. List the referrals to see which ones are still pending.

useCases.title: Add or subtract a customer's points
useCases.text: Add points to one customer, or subtract them, as a manual points event. Positive numbers add points and negative numbers subtract them.

useCases.title: Turn a reward on or off and manage favorites
useCases.text: Turn one loyalty reward on or off for customers. Add a product to a customer's favorites or remove it.
